summary: Depot definitions used as start/end anchors and pickup/delivery sources for jobs.
range: Array of depot objects. Each requires id + location_index.
constraints: Each depot requires id and location_index.
businessRules: depots defines: depots object is used to collect the details of a depot. Depots can be used as a starting point and/or ending point for the routes and vehicles. They also can be used to fulfil pickup and delivery …
Each element in depots must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Must stay consistent with: depots.location_index, vehicles.start_depot_ids. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Shipments: pickup always occurs before delivery on the route.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: two depots referenced by vehicles' start/end_depot_ids.
Interaction: Positive: two depots north/south, demand split by region -> each vehicle serves its nearby cluster.
Interaction: Infeasible: job depot_ids incompatible with any vehicle's depots -> unassigned.
